snippet.title: Dewazma - Official Trailer | KoldFlame
snippet.description:
Dewazma - Official Trailer | KoldFlame

یاری دێوەزمە یەکەمین یاری ترسناکی کوردییە کە لەلایەن ڕێکخراوی کۆڵدفلەیم بەرهەم هێنراوە.

Dewzma is the first horror game set entirely in Kurdistan.

Platforms: PC (Later on Mobile, Xbox, Playstation)

KoldFlame is the first game development company based in Kurdistan.
